title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Advance the dev3 source candidate through current-baseline qualification and complete the production entropy binding without bypassing the common socket or crypto authorities.
invariants: Execute the expanded protocol and platform-crypto contract suites under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196.
Execute independent COTS tests against Socket Provider dev16 before promotion.
Exercise fragmented TEXT/BINARY messages with interleaved PING/PONG and both local and peer close paths on wire.
Bind WebSocketEntropySource to the estate production cryptographic/randomness authority and qualify exact 16-byte nonce and four-byte mask delivery.
Do not add another RNG, shell-command crypto or a WebSocket-owned OpenSSL binding.
Add extension negotiation only through explicit extension objects and fail closed for unsupported negotiated extensions.
Treat RFC 8441 and RFC 9220 as explicit WebSocket-over-HTTP/2 and WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 compositions; ordinary RFC 6455 Upgrade does not implement them.
Keep browser, Queue Fabric, RPC, Wire UI and application semantics above WebSocket.
Preserve full ooRexx objects through every selector/provider seam.
Use Rasen Falcon componentId websocket-access for all project coordination for this lane.
